source_scope: Initially only verified native UK Lords written answers. Oral/NI/Scottish/London debate rows do not automatically fit this grammar.
generic_rule: Question-led state machine accumulates ALL consecutive attributed questions, literal topic headings and To ask continuation paragraphs until the first substantive attributed answer. The whole answer, tables, footnotes, quotations and attachment labels remain indivisible. Only a recognized new heading/question AFTER an answer begins a new group. Multiple final Beecham questions sharing one Faulks answer must stay together.
no_cropping: Ambiguous heading/speaker transitions, orphan replies and unanswered questions retain exact held spans. No handpicked independent paragraphs, rewritten answer, or deletion of unavailable-attachment reference. Prefix/suffix remain preserved source sidecars.
custody: Exact raw character+UTF8 byte intervals, original row/text SHA and group raw SHA; inverse equality and exhaustive nonoverlapping partition of every source character including whitespace. Original full rows untouched.
quality: Table presence alone is not exclusion. Actual missing column relationships or required missing Excel/Table attachments can hold that group only. External prior-answer/library references remain dependency flags, not silently supplied facts. All existing source/rights/language/family/leakage holds preserved.
family: Retain full native day/source ancestry for all groups and aliases; no same-day cross-split assignment or inferred family clearance. SourceID day is not full-day completeness proof.
next_step: Parent architecture review, then synthetic-only finite grammar/code/controls and frozen profile, then separate reviewed retained-source diagnostic. No producer implementation or retained-source segmentation in this proposal.
required_synthetic_controls: single complete QA exact exhaustive partition
two question blocks one common answer stays one group
unlabelled same-speaker To ask continuation stays with group
same topic repeats after completed answer => separate intact groups
table/footnote/attachment remains in answer group with additive dependency flag
